items.title: Why Moderna’s Biggest New Questions May Make Sense Through ETFs
items.summary: If you like Moderna but hold it directly, your portfolio lives or dies with its own swings. Simply Wall St points to significant insider selling over the past 3 months, which can worry some investors. Owning Moderna inside a fund spreads that single business across a basket of companies. Your upside from any one stock shrinks, and so does the impact of those company specific risks on your overall holdings. The latest news is a sharp move in Moderna’s story.
